# Frozentech03

Personal site of Lester Santiago Soriano (frozentech03.github.io).

Lester Santiago Soriano is a Staff Software Engineer based in Singapore. He has nearly 20 years of experience building backend systems for payments, fintech, and digital commerce.

## Facts
- Location: Singapore
- Role: Staff Software Engineer at NTUC Enterprise Nexus Co-operative Limited (Jan 2025 - present)
- Focus: Go microservices, payments, fintech backends, APIs (REST, gRPC, Protobuf), GCP and AWS
- Earlier companies: MatchMove Pay, Red Dot Payment, Security Bank Corporation
- Education: BS Information Technology, Saint Louis University (2000-2005)
- Spoken languages: English, Filipino
- Currently studying: Model Context Protocol (MCP) and large language models (LLMs)
